author_or_institution: Joel Becker; Nate Rush; Beth Barnes; David Rein / METR
title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity
book_use: Counterevidence from 16 experienced open-source developers completing 246 real tasks in familiar repositories: early-2025 AI tools increased completion time by 19% despite developers predicting and later perceiving speedups; study explicitly cautions against generalizing to all software work.
